settings.promo_text: A more comfortable bed starts with one layer.
settings.subtitle: A thick, quilted comfort layer designed to make your existing mattress feel softer and more inviting.
settings.benefit_3: Made for home and hotel-style bedding
settings.shipping_text: Shipping timing and tracking details are shown at checkout and in your order confirmation.
settings.action_heading: See the comfort from every angle
settings.action_body: Use real product photos and video here to show the loft, quilting and how the topper sits on a finished bed.
settings.story_heading: Make your mattress feel noticeably plusher
settings.story_body:
You do not always need a new mattress to change the feel of your bed. A thick, quilted pillow-top layer adds softness on top of the mattress you already own.

The result is a more inviting sleep surface with the visual finish of a hotel-style bed.
settings.features_body: A simple construction story: plush fill, quilted structure and an easy way to add softness to the bed you already have.
settings.comparison_heading: More than a thin mattress cover
settings.guarantee_heading: Know the terms before you buy
settings.guarantee_body: Your purchase is covered by the store policies shown at checkout. Review the return terms before ordering so there are no surprises.

settings.tagline: Comfort-focused bedding for a softer, more inviting sleep space.
